justification: Panel A depicts a large winged genie facing a griffin-demon in a single narrative scene rendered in a naturalistic, high-relief carving style, while Panel B is a dense multi-register composition combining small rows of human figures with extensive columns of hieroglyphic-like script, resembling a stele or inscribed tablet rather than a figural relief. The only broad commonality is the presence of standing human-like figures in profile and a winged element, but the specific forms, proportions, relationships (confronting demon vs. flanking ritual figures under a sun disc), and overall arrangement (single large scene vs. registers of text and small figures) are entirely different.
